task_description: Fix the production 'User not found.' bug (in-memory user store is empty on a fresh Vercel serverless isolate after login) by replacing the three in-memory module-singleton stores (users, books, reviews) with hosted-Supabase-Postgres-backed implementations behind the UNCHANGED store interfaces. Backend is selected at construction time: Supabase when SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are present, otherwise fall back to the existing in-memory stores so build/tests/lint/dev stay green keyless. Add pure mapper unit tests, and update .env.example + README.
